routes.authorization_rationale: Can invoke trading/lifecycle work; must authorize before owner dispatch.
routes.source_of_truth: Operational timestamped price event; existing PriceFeedServiceV2 -> LivePositionMonitorV2 -> TradeLifecycleServiceV2. Does not publish L1.
routes.freshness_policy: PriceFeedServiceV2 event freshness/order under APISettings.maximum_quote_age_seconds; API requires aware timestamp and operational source.
routes.unavailable_behavior: Missing feed 503; stale/future/invalid price or timestamp 400/422 before feed/monitor state mutation.

routes.authorization_rationale: Can invoke trading/lifecycle work; must authorize before owner dispatch.
routes.source_of_truth: LiveCandleStore stores supplied OHLC; canonical lifecycle owns execution. OHLC never synthesizes L1.
routes.freshness_policy: RuntimeSpreadAuthorityV2 validates L1; LiveMarketAnalysisService signal gate validates signal age; webhook operational price additionally delegated to PriceFeedServiceV2. No router age math.
routes.unavailable_behavior: 503 before writes in coordinated runtime with incompatible legacy manager. Webhook also rejects a disconnected existing legacy position before writes. Compatible ingestion may acknowledge stored historical candles while price processing explicitly reports false; missing/stale L1 prevents executable analysis.
